answer: An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the wander check immediately, the ivory audit keeps the resolved set and the meadow replay makes public exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 101 aliases thus pays the reading cost 101 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
